text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
US(x) ::: x is in the US.
F1Visa(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1Visa(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
NeedsToApplyForOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
Mike ::: a specific individual named Mike.

Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ US(x) → (F1Visa(x) ∨ J1Visa(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ US(x) ∧ F1Visa(x) ∧ WantsToWork(x) → (NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ∨ NeedsToApplyForOPT(x))) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work.
InternationalStudent(Mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
WantsToWork(Mike) ::: Mike wants to work in the US.
NeedsToApplyForCPT(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work.

Conclusion:
∃x (J1Visa(x) ∧ Mike = x) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
